Hold Shift while placing a piece to keep adding identical pieces.
With the board highlighted, you can move from square to square using the arrow keys.
With a highlighted square on the board, press the key corresponding to the piece to add it there (e.g. press "p" to add a black pawn, "Q" for a white queen, etc.).
Hold Shift while moving a piece to clone it instead of moving it.
You can now change the board colors in the configuration page.
You can now create a snapshot of the current position and restore it later.
If you paste a FEN with the board highlighted (CTRL+V or CMD+V on Mac), it is applied to the board.
